evidence.note: Agent counts total test functions (1103, then 1301, 'need 3000+') — this is scope enumeration, not a pass/fail ledger; it never establishes which of these pass.
Continues assessing feasibility and total test volume but never runs cargo build/test, so no per-crate pass/fail status is ever tracked; no ledger of done vs remaining is created.

Submits 'task complete' three times citing intractability, having implemented and verified nothing — there was no forward progress to monitor and no detection of green/stuck crates because no work occurred.

reasoning: The agent only ever enumerated the total test population (a scope/contract activity) and never ran any build or test, so it could not say which crates pass or how many tests remain green — it maintained no running tally, tracked no per-crate status, and detected no regressions or loops because it did zero implementation. This maps to the bottom of the scale: essentially no sense of actual progress (anchor 0), lifted marginally to 1 only because it repeatedly quantified the total test horizon.
